bandReport.notes: Band b1 = Q1-Q59 across the 11 EVEN-indexed English pages p02..p22 (there are no odd-numbered files and that is not a gap). Per-page: p02 Q1-Q6, p04 Q7-Q11, p06 Q12-Q16, p08 Q17-Q21, p10 Q22-Q27, p12 Q28-Q33, p14 Q34-Q38, p16 Q39-Q44, p18 Q45-Q49, p20 Q50-Q54, p22 Q55-Q59. LAYOUT is two-column throughout: read the LEFT column top-to-bottom then the RIGHT column, and the numbering follows that order. On SIX pages a question's stem ends the left column while its options print at the top of the right column (Q9 on p04, Q14 on p06, Q19 on p08, Q36 on p14, Q47 on p18, Q52 on p20) - that is ordinary column flow WITHIN one page, not a page-straddle, but a naive per-column read would strand those four options. SEAMS: Q1 is the paper's first question, so nothing precedes p02. Q59 is COMPLETE on p22 - stem, both statements, the code line and all four options all print there. I opened p24 (band b2's first page, which I did not transcribe): it opens cleanly at Q60 in the left column, and the two option rows at the top of its right column belong to Q62, whose own stem sits at the bottom of p24's left column. So NOTHING straddles the p22/p24 boundary in either direction. DIRECTIONS SETS: there are NONE anywhere in p02-p22 - no 'Directions:' block and no 'Consider the following for the next N (0N) items' block - so every question here is a standalone MCQ, this band opens no set and inherits none, and no question carries context or setLabel. p24 was checked for the same and also carries no Directions block, so nothing is pending across the seam. FIGURES: NONE in this band. No stem anywhere in p02-p22 says 'in the figure given below' or otherwise refers to a printed diagram; every geometry and mensuration item (Q36, Q45, Q46, Q48, Q49, Q50, Q52, Q53, Q54, Q55, Q56, Q57, Q58, Q59) states all its data in words. Verified by reading each of the 11 page images in full at native resolution. CONFIG CHECK - the three facts recorded in config.ts all held: p02 IS Q1-Q6 in English with printed page number 3 and footer 'A - KPRS-T-MTE'; printed page = index + 1 held on all 11 pages (p04->5, p06->7 ... p22->23); and p02 does carry 6 questions. The one figure that is LOW is the density estimate: config says ~4.8 q/page, and this band runs 59 q over 11 pages = 5.4 q/page. DECIMALS: the booklet sets a raised middle dot and these are transcribed as full stops per the brief - Q25 (3.6, 0.009, 0.27 and options 5.4/10.8/16.2/21.6), Q26 (13.3, 20.9 and options 1.7/1.9/2.1/2.3), Q32 (6.2 kg), Q33 (31.6%), Q39 (options 3.25/3.50/3.75/4.25), Q54 (2.4 cm and options 6.0/6.4/7.2/8.4). CURRENCY: Q12 and Q32 print the rupee glyph; transcribed as 'Rs.' following the corpus convention (the sibling bands use 'Rs.' 37 times and contain zero rupee glyphs). MISPRINTS: no answer-affecting misprint was found in this band. Two harmless printed oddities are transcribed exactly as printed rather than repaired - Q22 words its two statements inconsistently ('HCF of p and (p + q) is G' vs 'HCF of p, (p - q) is G', comma for 'and'), and Q54 reads 'The diagonal BD and line segment AE intersects at F' (singular verb for a compound subject). Neither changes any quantity. INVENTED SUBTOPIC: Q5 only - 'Trailing Zeros and Factors of Ten' under Number System, because the catalog's Number System list has no entry for counting trailing zeros / powers of ten; the nearest listed, 'Prime Numbers and Factorisation', understates it. Flagged on the question. AMBIGUOUS GLYPHS re-read from the source PDF at 7-12x before transcription: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Q5, Q6, Q7, Q8, Q10, Q12, Q13, Q15, Q19, Q20, Q21 (exponents 27/40/79 needed a 12x re-crop with headroom), Q25, Q26, Q29, Q30, Q33, Q35, Q36, Q39, Q40, Q41, Q42, Q43, Q44, Q47, Q48, Q49, Q50, Q52, Q53, Q54, Q55, Q56, Q57, Q58, Q59. Nothing in this band was left as a guess between two readings.

questions.stem: If \(p + q + r = 0\), then what is \(z^{\frac{p^2}{qr}} \times z^{\frac{q^2}{rp}} \times z^{\frac{r^2}{pq}}\) equal to ?

If \(\frac{1}{x} = \frac{1}{p} + \frac{1}{q}\), then what is \(\frac{pq}{p^2 - q^2}\left(\frac{x + p}{x - p} - \frac{x + q}{x - q}\right)\) equal to ?
